shots.focal_element: Archival photo/footage of a cable-strewn early server rack standing in an office, pointed at by a white label and arrow
shots.typography: Lowercase geometric sans (low-confidence guess: Google Sans / Product Sans-like), medium-bold weight, normal tracking, white, set in two lines left of frame with a short white arrow pointing right at the rack
shots.what_happens: Low-resolution, pillarboxed archival image of the first web server holds while the VO says 'the world we live in' (w19-w23); a hand-added lowercase caption and arrow annotate it like a documentary callout.
shots.build_rebuild: Place a pillarboxed archival still at full height on black, then overlay a two-line white lowercase sans label with a 2px white arrow to its right, left-third aligned and pointing at the subject, cut in on the shot start.

shots.focal_element: Long data-centre aisle between rows of server racks with blinking LEDs, vanishing point centred
shots.what_happens: Stock-style dolly shot down a dark server aisle; between the two samples the exposure lifts sharply from dim to brightly lit, landing on 'transformed' (w25) as the scale jump from one rack to a whole data centre.
shots.build_rebuild: Cut to a symmetric one-point-perspective data-centre dolly clip and ramp its exposure/brightness up over roughly the last half second of the shot so it blooms into the next clip.

shots.focal_element: Brightly lit data-centre aisle, then a presenter on a dark keynote stage looking at a phone
shots.what_happens: The bright server aisle continues under 'the way we access' (w26-w29); by the last sample the frame already shows a keynote presenter holding a phone, so the cut to s010's material appears to land inside this shot's range.
shots.build_rebuild: Crossfade from the previous aisle clip into a brighter take of the same aisle, then hard cut to stage footage of a presenter with a handheld device on 'access information'.

shots.focal_element: Keynote presenter in a dark turtleneck tapping a phone, framed left-of-centre against a dark blue stage with light strips
shots.typography: Kinetic type on the final sample: heavy/black-weight uppercase grotesque sans, very tight tracking, white on black, filling the full frame width and horizontally motion-blurred
shots.what_happens: Archival keynote footage of a presenter using a phone plays under 'information. But then,' (w30-w32), dimming toward black; the last sample shows a frame-filling, motion-blurred 'BIG' slamming in ahead of the spoken 'big' (w34).
shots.build_rebuild: Play the archival clip, fade it toward black over ~0.5 s on 'But then', then hard cut to a full-bleed black card with a frame-wide heavy uppercase word that slides in horizontally with directional motion blur.

shots.focal_element: Single uppercase word 'HAPPEN' sliding across a black frame with horizontal motion blur
shots.typography: Bold uppercase grotesque sans, widely tracked (much looser than 'BIG'), mid-grey on black, trailing letters progressively more blurred; the word is cropped at the right edge so the full word (likely 'HAPPENED') cannot be confirmed
shots.what_happens: Kinetic word reveal synced to 'happened.' (w35): the tracked-out word whips in from the right with a motion-blur trail; by the last sample the frame has already cut to a TV news anchor at a desk.
shots.build_rebuild: On a black card, animate a widely tracked grey uppercase word in from the right with a strong ease-out and a per-letter horizontal blur that decays left to right, timed so it settles on the spoken word, then hard cut.

shots.focal_element: TV news anchor at a desk speaking to camera against a blue studio city backdrop
shots.typography: Broadcaster bug cropped at top-left (white lowercase sans on red over small uppercase); final sample shows a magazine cover with a large serif masthead and small uppercase serif cover lines
shots.what_happens: Borrowed news-broadcast clip of an anchor talking plays under 'Major development in artificial' (w36-w39) as social proof that AI is mainstream news; the last sample already shows a magazine cover with a red border on white, likely the start of the next montage beat.
shots.build_rebuild: Hard cut to a slightly punched-in broadcast clip of a news anchor (crop so the channel bug is partly cut off), hold ~1.5 s under the VO, then cut to a magazine-cover still centred on white with a soft drop shadow.
